name: Feature flags
summary: Deterministic rollout bucketing with exposure logging and A/B significance

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: FLAGS_EXPOSURE_SAMPLE_RATE
env.description: Fraction of exposures recorded, 0..1. Below 1 reduces write volume but widens confidence intervals proportionally.

env.name: FLAGS_DEFAULT_ON_ERROR
env.description: Value returned when evaluation fails. Defaults to false: a flag failing open turns an outage into an unreviewed feature launch.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Aggregate exposures and conversions into daily results, so the readout does not scan raw events.

operations.title: GET /evaluate
operations.description: Evaluate a flag for a subject and log exposure.

operations.title: GET /health
operations.description: Liveness and readiness, backed by the block's v_status view.
